title.en: Reading: A father's advice to his daughter
title.ur: Parhna: Baap ki apni beti ko naseehat

intro.en: A father advises his daughter on her wedding night. He tells her that marriage is a big responsibility, not a picnic. Read each paragraph slowly. Notice the word إِنَّ (inna – 'indeed'), which makes a sentence stronger.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein ek baap shaadi ki raat apni beti ko naseehat karta hai. Woh kehta hai ke shaadi ek bari zimmedari hai, sair-tafreeh nahin. Har hissa aahista parhein. Lafz إِنَّ (inna – 'beshak') par dhyan dein, yeh baat ko mazboot banata hai.
intro.ar: أَبٌ يُوصي ابْنَتَهُ لَيْلَةَ زَفافِها، وَيُخْبِرُها أَنَّ الزَّواجَ مَسْؤولِيَّةٌ كَبيرَةٌ وَلَيْسَ نُزْهَةً. نَقْرَأُ كُلَّ فِقْرَةٍ بِبُطْءٍ، وَنَنْتَبِهُ لِكَلِمَةِ «إِنَّ» الَّتي تُقَوّي الجُمْلَةَ.

dialogue.ar: وَصَّى أَبٌ ابْنَتَهُ لَيْلَةَ الزَّواجِ فَقالَ: إِنَّ الزَّواجَ يا ابْنَتي لَيْسَ نُزْهَةً.
dialogue.tr: waṣṣā abun ibnatahu laylata z-zawāj, fa-qāl: inna z-zawāja yā ibnatī laysa nuzhah
dialogue.en: A father advised his daughter on her wedding night and said: Marriage, my daughter, is not a picnic.
dialogue.ur: Ek baap ne shaadi ki raat apni beti ko naseehat ki aur kaha: Beti, shaadi sair-tafreeh nahin hai.

dialogue.ar: وَإِنَّما هُوَ مَسْؤُولِيَّةٌ كَبيرَةٌ، مَسْؤُولِيَّةُ القِيامِ بِشُؤُونِ أُسْرَةٍ كامِلَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: wa-innamā huwa masʾūliyyatun kabīrah, masʾūliyyatu l-qiyāmi bi-shuʾūni usratin kāmilah
dialogue.en: It is a big responsibility: looking after the affairs of a whole family.
dialogue.ur: Yeh ek bari zimmedari hai: poore khandaan ke kaamon ko sambhalna.

dialogue.ar: تَبْدَأُ بِالاهْتِمامِ بِشُؤُونِ شَريكِها في رِحْلَةِ الحَياةِ، ثُمَّ لا تَلْبَثُ أَنْ تَشْمَلَ الأَبْناءَ وَالبَناتِ، ثُمَّ الأَحْفادَ.
dialogue.tr: tabdaʾu bil-ihtimāmi bi-shuʾūni sharīkihā fī riḥlati l-ḥayāh, thumma lā talbathu an tashmala l-abnāʾa wal-banāt, thumma l-aḥfād
dialogue.en: It begins with caring for your partner on life's journey, then soon includes the sons and daughters, then the grandchildren.
dialogue.ur: Yeh zindagi ke safar ke saathi ki fikr se shuru hoti hai, phir jald hi beton, betiyon aur phir potay-nawason tak pahunch jati hai.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّها مَسْؤُولِيَّةُ تَرْبِيَةِ أَبْناءِ الأُمَّةِ وَبَناتِها.
dialogue.tr: innahā masʾūliyyatu tarbiyati abnāʾi l-ummati wa-banātihā
dialogue.en: It is the responsibility of raising the sons and daughters of the nation.
dialogue.ur: Yeh qaum ke beton aur betiyon ki tarbiyat ki zimmedari hai.

dialogue.ar: وَإِنَّ لِلتَّرْبِيَةِ المَنْزِلِيَّةِ دَوْراً كَبيراً في إِعْطاءِ الأُمَّةِ هُوِيَّتَها، وَفي حِفاظِها عَلى كَيانِها.
dialogue.tr: wa-inna lit-tarbiyati l-manziliyyati dawran kabīran fī iʿṭāʾi l-ummati huwiyyatahā, wa-fī ḥifāẓihā ʿalā kayānihā
dialogue.en: Home upbringing plays a big role in giving the nation its identity and keeping its existence safe.
dialogue.ur: Ghar ki tarbiyat qaum ko uski pehchaan dene aur uske wujood ko mehfooz rakhne mein bara kirdar ada karti hai.

dialogue.ar: بَعْضُ البَناتِ يَتَزَوَّجْنَ تَخَلُّصاً مِنْ قُيُودِ آبائِهِنَّ، مُتَصَوِّراتٍ أَنَّ الزَّواجَ حَياةٌ تَخْلُو مِنَ القُيُودِ، وَهذا ظَنٌّ خاطِئٌ جِدّاً.
dialogue.tr: baʿḍu l-banāti yatazawwajna takhalluṣan min quyūdi ābāʾihinna, mutaṣawwirātin anna z-zawāja ḥayātun takhlū mina l-quyūd, wa-hādhā ẓannun khāṭiʾun jiddan
dialogue.en: Some girls marry to escape their fathers' restrictions, imagining marriage is a life without restrictions. This is a very wrong idea.
dialogue.ur: Kuch ladkiyan apne walid ki pabandiyon se chhutkara paane ke liye shaadi karti hain, yeh samajh kar ke shaadi pabandiyon se khali zindagi hai. Yeh bahut ghalat khayal hai.

dialogue.ar: لِأَنَّ الآباءَ لا قُيُودَ عِنْدَهُمْ ضِدَّ مَصْلَحَةِ البَناتِ وَسَعادَتِهِنَّ، هذا في الغالِبِ الأَعَمِّ مِنَ النَّاسِ، وَالشّاذُّ لا حُكْمَ لَهُ.
dialogue.tr: li-anna l-ābāʾa lā quyūda ʿindahum ḍidda maṣlaḥati l-banāti wa-saʿādatihinn, hādhā fī l-ghālibi l-aʿammi mina n-nās, wash-shādhdhu lā ḥukma lah
dialogue.en: Because fathers have no restrictions against their daughters' good and happiness. This is true of most people, and the rare exception has no rule.
dialogue.ur: Kyunke walid ke paas beti ki bhalai aur khushi ke khilaf koi pabandi nahin hoti. Yeh aksar logon ke baare mein sahi hai, aur shaaz (nadir) baat ka koi hukm nahin.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّ الحُرِّيَّةَ المُطْلَقَةَ شَرٌّ وَدَمارٌ.
dialogue.tr: inna l-ḥurriyyata l-muṭlaqata sharrun wa-damār
dialogue.en: Absolute freedom is evil and destruction.
dialogue.ur: Be-qaid (mutlaq) azaadi buraai aur tabahi hai.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّ الزَّواجَ يا ابْنَتي لَيْسَ راحَةً وَنَوْماً مُتَواصِلاً، وَإِنَّما هُوَ عَمَلٌ وَتَخْطيطٌ.
dialogue.tr: inna z-zawāja yā ibnatī laysa rāḥatan wa-nawman mutawāṣilan, wa-innamā huwa ʿamalun wa-takhṭīṭ
dialogue.en: Marriage, my daughter, is not rest and endless sleep. It is work and planning.
dialogue.ur: Beti, shaadi aaraam aur musalsal neend nahin, balke kaam aur mansooba-bandi hai.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّ الزَّوْجَةَ النّاجِحَةَ هِيَ الَّتي تَعْمَلُ بِضْعَ عَشْرَةَ ساعَةً في بَيْتِها.
dialogue.tr: inna z-zawjata n-nājiḥata hiya llatī taʿmalu biḍʿa ʿashrata sāʿatan fī baytihā
dialogue.en: The successful wife is the one who works about thirteen hours in her home.
dialogue.ur: Kamyab biwi woh hai jo apne ghar mein terah ke qareeb ghante kaam karti hai.

dialogue.ar: خُذي يا ابْنَتي دَرْساً مُفيداً مِمّا نَرى وَنَسْمَعُ.
dialogue.tr: khudhī yā ibnatī darsan mufīdan mimmā narā wa-nasmaʿ
dialogue.en: Take a useful lesson, my daughter, from what we see and hear.
dialogue.ur: Beti, jo kuch hum dekhte aur sunte hain us se ek faida-mand sabaq lo.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّنا نَسْمَعُ حَوادِثَ طَلاقٍ كَثيرَةً لِشابّاتٍ.
dialogue.tr: innanā nasmaʿu ḥawāditha ṭalāqin kathīratan li-shābbāt
dialogue.en: We hear of many cases of divorce among young women.
dialogue.ur: Hum naujawan auraton ki talaq ke bohat se waqiat sunte hain.

dialogue.ar: اعْلَمي يا ابْنَتي أَنَّ الزَّوْجَ قَدْ يَحْتَمِلُ أَنْ يَمْشِيَ ساعَةً في شارِعٍ مَلِيءٍ بِالتُّرابِ وَالنُّفاياتِ، وَلكِنَّهُ لا يَسْتَطيعُ أَنْ يَجْلِسَ في بَيْتِهِ دَقيقَةً عَلى كُرْسِيٍّ مُغَطًّى بِالتُّرابِ.
dialogue.tr: iʿlamī yā ibnatī anna z-zawja qad yaḥtamilu an yamshiya sāʿatan fī shāriʿin malīʾin bit-turābi wan-nufāyāt, wa-lākinnahu lā yastaṭīʿu an yajlisa fī baytihi daqīqatan ʿalā kursiyyin mughaṭṭan bit-turāb
dialogue.en: Know, my daughter, that a husband may bear walking an hour in a street full of dust and rubbish, but he cannot sit one minute at home on a chair covered with dust.
dialogue.ur: Beti, jaan lo ke shauhar ek ghanta gard aur kachre se bhari sarak par chal sakta hai, magar apne ghar mein ek minute bhi mitti se dhaki kursi par nahin baith sakta.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّ الزَّوْجَ يَعُودُ مِنْ عَمَلِهِ مُتْعَباً، عِنْدَما يَفْتَحُ بابَ دارِهِ، يَتَوَقَّعُ أَنْ يُقابَلَ مِنَ الزَّوْجَةِ الحَبيبَةِ بِالابْتِسامَةِ الحُلْوَةِ، وَالكَلِمَةِ الطَّيِّبَةِ، وَالوَجْهِ المُشْرِقِ.
dialogue.tr: inna z-zawja yaʿūdu min ʿamalihi mutʿaban, ʿindamā yaftaḥu bāba dārihi, yatawaqqaʿu an yuqābala mina z-zawjati l-ḥabībati bil-ibtisāmati l-ḥulwah, wal-kalimati ṭ-ṭayyibah, wal-wajhi l-mushriq
dialogue.en: The husband returns from work tired. When he opens his door he expects to be met by his dear wife with a sweet smile, a kind word and a bright face.
dialogue.ur: Shauhar thaka hua kaam se lauta hai. Jab woh ghar ka darwaza kholta hai to umeed karta hai ke pyari biwi meethi muskurahat, achhi baat aur roshan chehre se istiqbal karegi.

dialogue.ar: إِذا أَرَدْتِ أَنْ تَطولَ حَياةُ زَوْجِكِ، فَابْتَسِمي لَهُ.
dialogue.tr: idhā aradti an taṭūla ḥayātu zawjiki, fa-btasimī lah
dialogue.en: If you want your husband's life to be long, smile at him.
dialogue.ur: Agar tum chahti ho ke tumhare shauhar ki umar lambi ho, to us ke saamne muskurao.

dialogue.ar: اعْلَمي يا ابْنَتي أَنَّ اهْتِمامَ بَناتِ اليَوْمِ بِأُمُورٍ تافِهَةٍ، وَإِنَّهُنَّ يُغْفِلْنَ الأُمُورَ الأَساسِيَّةَ في الحَياةِ الزَّوْجِيَّةِ السَّعيدَةِ.
dialogue.tr: iʿlamī yā ibnatī anna ihtimāma banāti l-yawmi bi-umūrin tāfihah, wa-innahunna yughfilna l-umūra l-asāsiyyata fī l-ḥayāti z-zawjiyyati s-saʿīdah
dialogue.en: Know, my daughter, that today's girls care about trivial things and neglect the basic things of a happy married life.
dialogue.ur: Beti, jaan lo ke aaj ki ladkiyan maamooli cheezon ki fikr karti hain aur khushgawar shaadi-shuda zindagi ki buniyadi baaton ko nazar-andaaz kar deti hain.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّ الشَّقَّةَ وَالتِّلْفازَ وَالسَّيّارَةَ لا تُوَفِّرُ السَّعادَةَ.
dialogue.tr: inna sh-shaqqata wat-tilfāza was-sayyārata lā tuwaffiru s-saʿādah
dialogue.en: The flat, the television and the car do not provide happiness.
dialogue.ur: Flat, television aur gaari khushi muhayya nahin karte.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّ القَلْبَ الكَبيرَ، وَالعَواطِفَ الدّافِئَةَ، وَالتَّفَهُّمَ العَميقَ، وَالتَّقْديرَ الكَبيرَ، وَالحُبَّ الحَقيقِيَّ، كُلُّ أُولئِكَ هِيَ الَّتي تُحَقِّقُ السَّعادَةَ.
dialogue.tr: inna l-qalba l-kabīra, wal-ʿawāṭifa d-dāfiʾah, wat-tafahhuma l-ʿamīq, wat-taqdīra l-kabīr, wal-ḥubba l-ḥaqīqiyy, kullu ulāʾika hiya llatī tuḥaqqiqu s-saʿādah
dialogue.en: A big heart, warm feelings, deep understanding, great appreciation and true love: all of these bring happiness.
dialogue.ur: Bara dil, garm jazbaat, gehri samajh, bari qadardani aur sacchi mohabbat, yeh sab khushi ko haasil karte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَاللهُ يُوَفِّقُكِ.
dialogue.tr: wallāhu yuwaffiqūki
dialogue.en: And may Allah grant you success.
dialogue.ur: Aur Allah tumhein kamyabi ata farmaye.

q.en: In the text, what does the father say marriage is NOT?
q.ur: Matan mein baap ke mutabiq shaadi kya NAHIN hai?
q.ar: ماذا يَقولُ الأَبُ إِنَّ الزَّواجَ لَيْسَ؟

q.en: What does the father say a husband expects when he comes home tired?
q.ur: Baap ke mutabiq thaka hua shauhar ghar aa kar kya umeed karta hai?
q.ar: ماذا يَنْتَظِرُ الزَّوْجُ حينَ يَعودُ إِلى البَيْتِ مُتْعَباً؟

options: A sweet smile, a kind word and a bright face
options_ar: ابْتِسامَةً حُلْوَةً وَكَلِمَةً طَيِّبَةً وَوَجْهاً مُشْرِقاً

q.en: Why do some girls marry, according to the text?
q.ur: Matan ke mutabiq kuch ladkiyan shaadi kyun karti hain?
q.ar: لِماذا تَتَزَوَّجُ بَعْضُ الفَتَياتِ بِحَسَبِ النَّصِّ؟

q.en: What does the father say does NOT bring happiness?
q.ur: Baap ke mutabiq kya cheez khushi nahin deti?
q.ar: ما الَّذي لا يَجْلِبُ السَّعادَةَ بِحَسَبِ الأَبِ؟

options: A flat, a television and a car

q.en: What does the word زَوْجَة mean?
q.ur: Lafz زَوْجَة ka kya matlab hai?

intro.en: Here you practise the father's text: put the ideas in order, answer questions, find opposites and fill in the blanks with إِنَّ (inna) and the phrase 'دَوْراً كَبيراً في' (a big role in). The answers are shown on the slides.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum matan ki mashq karte hain: khayalat ko tarteeb dena, sawalon ke jawab, ulte alfaaz dhoondna, aur إِنَّ aur 'دَوْراً كَبيراً في' (is mein bara kirdar) se khali jagah bharna. Jawab slides par maujood hain.
intro.ar: نَتَدَرَّبُ عَلى نَصِّ الأَبِ: نُرَتِّبُ الأَفْكارَ، وَنُجيبُ عَنِ الأَسْئِلَةِ، وَنَجِدُ الأَضْدادَ، وَنَمْلَأُ الفَراغاتِ بِـ «إِنَّ» وَبِعِبارَةِ «دَوْراً كَبيراً في». وَتَجِدُ الإِجاباتِ في الشَّرائِحِ.

q.en: What is the opposite of سَعيد (happy)?
q.ur: سَعيد (khush) ka ulta kya hai?

q.en: What does دَمار mean?
q.ur: دَمار ka kya matlab hai?

q.en: Complete: إِنَّ التَّرْبِيَةَ ... كَبيراً في بِناءِ الأَجْيالِ. Which word fits?
q.ur: Mukammal karein: إِنَّ التَّرْبِيَةَ ... كَبيراً في بِناءِ الأَجْيالِ. Kaunsa lafz theek hai?
q.ar: أَكْمِلْ: إِنَّ التَّرْبِيَةَ ... كَبيراً في بِناءِ الأَجْيالِ. أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تُناسِبُ؟

q.en: What does النَّشْء mean?
q.ur: النَّشْء ka kya matlab hai?

intro.en: The active participle names the person doing the action: from كَتَبَ (he wrote) we get كاتِب (writer). For simple three-letter verbs the pattern is فاعِل (e.g. سائِل 'asker', طارِق 'knocker'). For longer verbs it starts with مُ- (e.g. مُجاهِد 'one who strives', مُؤَذِّن 'caller to prayer').
intro.ur: Ism-ul-faail us shakhs ka naam hai jo kaam karta hai: كَتَبَ (usne likha) se كاتِب (likhne wala). Teen harfi aasaan fel se wazan فاعِل banta hai (jaise سائِل 'poochne wala'). Lambe fel se yeh مُ- se shuru hota hai (jaise مُجاهِد 'koshish karne wala', مُؤَذِّن 'azaan dene wala').
intro.ar: اسْمُ الفاعِلِ يَدُلُّ عَلى مَنْ يَقومُ بِالفِعْلِ: مِنْ «كَتَبَ» نَقولُ «كاتِب». وَيَأْتي مِنَ الثُّلاثِيِّ عَلى وَزْنِ «فاعِل» مِثْلِ سائِل وَطارِق، وَمِنْ غَيْرِ الثُّلاثِيِّ يَبْدَأُ بِمِيمٍ مَضْمومَةٍ مِثْلِ مُجاهِد وَمُؤَذِّن.

q.en: What is the active participle of كَتَبَ (he wrote)?
q.ur: كَتَبَ (usne likha) ka ism-ul-faail kya hai?

q.en: Which word means 'patient (one who is patient)'?
q.ur: Kaunsa lafz 'sabr karne wala' hai?

q.en: Which is an active participle of a longer verb (starts with مُ)?
q.ur: Kaunsa lambe fel ka ism-ul-faail hai (مُ se shuru)?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ اسْمُ فاعِلٍ مِنْ فِعْلٍ غَيْرِ ثُلاثِيٍّ (تَبْدَأُ بِمُ)؟

q.en: What does مُؤَذِّن mean?
q.ur: مُؤَذِّن ka kya matlab hai?

title.en: Listening: a son who travels to study
title.ur: Sunna: beta jo parhne ke liye safar karta hai

intro.en: Listen to the two parts of the story about a son who travels abroad to study, and about students who live away from home. Then answer true/false questions, put events in order and choose the right answer. Listen to the audio on the slides.
intro.ur: Ek beta jo parhne ke liye pardes jata hai aur woh talba jo ghar se door rehte hain, is kahani ke do hisse sunein. Phir sahi/ghalat ke sawal, waqiat ki tarteeb aur sahi jawab chunein. Audio slides par hai.
intro.ar: نَسْتَمِعُ إِلى جُزْأَيْ قِصَّةِ ابْنٍ يُسافِرُ لِلدِّراسَةِ في الخارِجِ، وَطُلّابٍ يَعيشونَ بَعيداً عَنْ بُيوتِهِمْ. ثُمَّ نُجيبُ عَنْ أَسْئِلَةِ الصَّوابِ وَالخَطَأِ، وَنُرَتِّبُ الأَحْداثَ، وَنَخْتارُ الإِجابَةَ الصَّحيحَةَ. نَسْتَمِعُ إِلى الصَّوْتِ في الشَّرائِحِ.

dialogue.ar: سافَرَ الابْنُ لِيَتَعَلَّمَ.
dialogue.tr: sāfara l-ibnu li-yataʿallam
dialogue.en: The son travelled in order to learn.
dialogue.ur: Beta seekhne ke liye safar par gaya.

dialogue.ar: وافَقَ الأَبُ عَلى سَفَرِ ابْنِهِ بَعْدَ تَفْكيرٍ عَميقٍ.
dialogue.tr: wāfaqa l-abu ʿalā safari ibnihi baʿda tafkīrin ʿamīq
dialogue.en: The father agreed to his son's travel after deep thought.
dialogue.ur: Baap ne gehri soch ke baad bete ke safar ki ijazat di.

dialogue.ar: أَصْبَحَتِ الأُسْرَةُ سَعيدَةً بَعْدَ سَفَرِ وَلَدِها.
dialogue.tr: aṣbaḥati l-usratu saʿīdatan baʿda safari waladihā
dialogue.en: The family became happy after their son's travel.
dialogue.ur: Beta ke safar ke baad khandaan khush ho gaya.

dialogue.ar: الأُسْرَةُ تُوافِقُ عَلى سَفَرِ الابْنِ.
dialogue.tr: al-usratu tuwāfiqu ʿalā safari l-ibn
dialogue.en: The family agrees to the son's travel.
dialogue.ur: Khandaan bete ke safar par razi hota hai.

dialogue.ar: الابْنُ يُقَرِّرُ الدِّراسَةَ في أُورُوبّا.
dialogue.tr: al-ibnu yuqarriru d-dirāsata fī ūrūbbā
dialogue.en: The son decides to study in Europe.
dialogue.ur: Beta Europe mein parhne ka faisla karta hai.

dialogue.ar: الأَبُ يَكْتُبُ رِسالَةً إِلى ابْنِهِ.
dialogue.tr: al-abu yaktubu risālatan ilā ibnih
dialogue.en: The father writes a letter to his son.
dialogue.ur: Baap apne bete ko khat likhta hai.

dialogue.ar: بَعْضُ الطُّلّابِ لا يَرْجِعونَ إِلى بِلادِهِمْ.
dialogue.tr: baʿḍu ṭ-ṭullābi lā yarjiʿūna ilā bilādihim
dialogue.en: Some students do not return to their countries.
dialogue.ur: Kuch talba apne mulkon ko wapas nahin lautte.

dialogue.ar: يُعْطي الطُّلّابُ المُغْتَرِبونَ صورَةً عَنْ ثَقافَةِ بِلادِهِمْ.
dialogue.tr: yuʿṭī ṭ-ṭullābu l-mughtaribūna ṣūratan ʿan thaqāfati bilādihim
dialogue.en: Students living abroad give a picture of their country's culture.
dialogue.ur: Pardes mein rehne wale talba apne mulk ki saqafat ki tasveer pesh karte hain.

q.en: Why did the son travel, in the first part?
q.ur: Pehle hisse mein beta kyun gaya?
q.ar: لِماذا سافَرَ الابْنُ في الجُزْءِ الأَوَّلِ؟

q.en: What does الاغْتِراب mean?
q.ur: الاغْتِراب ka kya matlab hai?

q.en: What do students abroad give a picture of?
q.ur: Pardes mein talba kis ki tasveer pesh karte hain?
q.ar: ماذا يُقَدِّمُ الطُّلّابُ في الخارِجِ صورَةً عَنْهُ؟

q.en: The father agreed to his son's travel after...
q.ur: Baap bete ke safar par kis ke baad razi hua?
q.ar: وافَقَ الأَبُ عَلى سَفَرِ ابْنِهِ بَعْدَ...

title.en: Speaking and writing: marriage and the returning son
title.ur: Guftagu aur likhna: shaadi aur wapas na aane wala beta

intro.en: Discuss with a partner whether you agree with statements about marriage and give a reason. Then explain Quran verses and hadiths (as given in the book), and write a story or an essay using the hints. No new rules here, just speaking and writing practice.
intro.ur: Kisi saathi ke saath baat karein ke shaadi ke baare mein in jumlon se aap muttafiq hain ya nahin, aur wajah batayein. Phir kitaab ke diye hue ayaat aur ahadees samjhayein, aur ishaaron ki madad se kahani ya mazmoon likhein. Yahan naye qawaid nahin, sirf bolne aur likhne ki mashq hai.
intro.ar: نُناقِشُ مَعَ زَميلٍ عِباراتٍ عَنِ الزَّواجِ وَنَقولُ هَلْ نُوافِقُ عَلَيْها مَعَ ذِكْرِ السَّبَبِ. ثُمَّ نَشْرَحُ آياتٍ وَأَحاديثَ كَما وَرَدَتْ في الكِتابِ، وَنَكْتُبُ قِصَّةً أَوْ مَقالَةً بِمُساعَدَةِ الإِشاراتِ. لا قَواعِدَ جَديدَةً هُنا، فَقَطْ تَدْريبٌ عَلى الكَلامِ وَالكِتابَةِ.

dialogue.ar: الزَّواجُ السَّعيدُ هُوَ الَّذي يَخْلو مِنَ المُشْكِلاتِ.
dialogue.tr: az-zawāju s-saʿīdu huwa lladhī yakhlū mina l-mushkilāt
dialogue.en: The happy marriage is the one free of problems.
dialogue.ur: Khushgawar shaadi woh hai jo masail se khali ho.

dialogue.ar: البَيْتُ السَّعيدُ يَقومُ عَلى الحِوارِ وَالتَّفاهُمِ.
dialogue.tr: al-baytu s-saʿīdu yaqūmu ʿalā l-ḥiwāri wat-tafāhum
dialogue.en: The happy home is built on dialogue and understanding.
dialogue.ur: Khush ghar baat-cheet aur ek doosre ko samajhne par qaim hota hai.

dialogue.ar: مِنْ أَهَمِّ أَهْدافِ الزَّواجِ الذُّرِّيَّةُ الصّالِحَةُ.
dialogue.tr: min ahammi ahdāfi z-zawāji dh-dhurriyyatu ṣ-ṣāliḥah
dialogue.en: Among the most important aims of marriage is righteous offspring.
dialogue.ur: Shaadi ke sab se ahem maqasid mein se nek aulad hai.

dialogue.ar: قالَ الرَّسولُ ﷺ: «خَيْرُكُمْ خَيْرُكُمْ لِأَهْلِهِ، وَأَنا خَيْرُكُمْ لِأَهْلي». رَواهُ التِّرْمِذِيُّ.
dialogue.tr: qāla r-rasūlu ﷺ: khayrukum khayrukum li-ahlih, wa-anā khayrukum li-ahlī. rawāhu t-Tirmidhī
dialogue.en: The Messenger ﷺ said: 'The best of you is the best to his family, and I am the best of you to my family.' Narrated by at-Tirmidhi.
dialogue.ur: Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya: 'Tum mein behtar woh hai jo apne ahl ke liye behtar ho, aur main apne ahl ke liye tum sab se behtar hoon.' Ise Tirmidhi ne riwayat kiya.

dialogue.ar: قالَ الرَّسولُ ﷺ: «اسْتَوْصُوا بِالنِّساءِ خَيْراً». رَواهُ البُخارِيُّ.
dialogue.tr: qāla r-rasūlu ﷺ: istawṣū bin-nisāʾi khayran. rawāhu l-Bukhārī
dialogue.en: The Messenger ﷺ said: 'Treat women well.' Narrated by al-Bukhari.
dialogue.ur: Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya: 'Auraton ke saath bhalai ki wasiyyat qubool karo.' Ise Bukhari ne riwayat kiya.

dialogue.ar: الابْنُ يَلْتَحِقُ بِجامِعَةٍ خارِجَ بِلادِهِ.
dialogue.tr: al-ibnu yaltaḥiqu bi-jāmiʿatin khārija bilādih
dialogue.en: The son joins a university outside his country.
dialogue.ur: Beta apne mulk se bahar ek university mein dakhila leta hai.

dialogue.ar: الابْنُ لا يَعودُ إِلى وَطَنِهِ.
dialogue.tr: al-ibnu lā yaʿūdu ilā waṭanih
dialogue.en: The son does not return to his homeland.
dialogue.ur: Beta apne watan wapas nahin aata.

dialogue.ar: تَموتُ الأُمُّ وَالأَبُ دونَ أَنْ يَراهُما ابْنُهُما.
dialogue.tr: tamūtu l-ummu wal-abu dūna an yarāhumā ibnuhumā
dialogue.en: The mother and father die without their son seeing them.
dialogue.ur: Maa aur baap is haal mein faut ho jate hain ke unka beta unhein nahin dekhta.

q.en: According to the hadith in the book, who is the best of people?
q.ur: Kitaab ki hadees ke mutabiq behtar kaun hai?
q.ar: بِحَسَبِ الحَديثِ في الكِتابِ، مَنْ هُوَ خَيْرُ النّاسِ؟

q.en: What does الحِوار mean?
q.ur: الحِوار ka kya matlab hai?

q.en: What does اسْتَوْصُوا بِالنِّساءِ خَيْراً ask us to do?
q.ur: اسْتَوْصُوا بِالنِّساءِ خَيْراً hum se kya kehta hai?

q.en: What does وَطَن mean?
q.ur: وَطَن ka kya matlab hai?

title.en: Grammar: the passive participle and spelling

intro.en: The passive participle names the one who receives the action: from حُفِظَ (it was kept) we get مَحْفوظ (kept, preserved). For simple verbs the pattern is مَفْعول (مَكْتوب 'written'); for longer verbs it starts with مُ- (مُكَرَّم 'honoured'). Then we practise spelling: the connecting hamza (همزة وصل), extra or dropped alif and wāw.
intro.ur: Ism-ul-mafool us cheez ka naam hai jis par kaam hota hai: حُفِظَ (mehfooz kiya gaya) se مَحْفوظ (mehfooz). Aasaan fel se wazan مَفْعول banta hai (مَكْتوب 'likha hua'); lambe fel se yeh مُ- se shuru hota hai (مُكَرَّم 'izzat diya gaya'). Phir imla ki mashq: hamzat-ul-wasl, alif aur waw ka izafa ya hazf.
intro.ar: اسْمُ المَفْعولِ يَدُلُّ عَلى مَنْ وَقَعَ عَلَيْهِ الفِعْلُ: مِنْ «حُفِظَ» نَقولُ «مَحْفوظ». وَيَأْتي مِنَ الثُّلاثِيِّ عَلى وَزْنِ «مَفْعول» مِثْلِ مَكْتوب، وَمِنْ غَيْرِ الثُّلاثِيِّ يَبْدَأُ بِمِيمٍ مَضْمومَةٍ مِثْلِ مُكَرَّم. ثُمَّ نَتَدَرَّبُ عَلى الإِمْلاءِ: هَمْزَةِ الوَصْلِ، وَزيادَةِ الأَلِفِ أَوِ الواوِ وَحَذْفِهِما.

q.en: What is the passive participle of عَرَفَ / عُرِفَ (known)?
q.ur: عُرِفَ (jaana gaya) ka ism-ul-mafool kya hai?

q.en: What does مَحْفوظ mean?
q.ur: مَحْفوظ ka kya matlab hai?

q.en: Which one is a passive participle?
q.ur: Kaunsa ism-ul-mafool hai?

q.en: What does مُغْلَقَة mean?
q.ur: مُغْلَقَة ka kya matlab hai?

intro.en: A review of the unit: meanings of verbs, finding the active participle (فاعِل / مُفْعِل) and the passive participle (مَفْعول / مُفْعَل), and using them in sentences. Check your answers on the slides.
intro.ur: Is unit ki dohrai: fel ke maani, ism-ul-faail (فاعِل / مُفْعِل) aur ism-ul-mafool (مَفْعول / مُفْعَل) pehchanna, aur unhein jumlon mein istemal karna. Apne jawab slides par dekhein.
intro.ar: مُراجَعَةٌ لِلوَحْدَةِ: مَعاني الأَفْعالِ، وَإيجادُ اسْمِ الفاعِلِ (فاعِل / مُفْعِل) وَاسْمِ المَفْعولِ (مَفْعول / مُفْعَل)، وَاسْتِعْمالُهُما في جُمَلٍ. تَحَقَّقْ مِنْ إِجاباتِكَ في الشَّرائِحِ.

q.en: Which word is an active participle (the doer)?
q.ur: Kaunsa lafz ism-ul-faail hai (kaam karne wala)?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ اسْمُ فاعِلٍ، أَيْ مَنْ يَقومُ بِالفِعْلِ؟

q.en: Which word is a passive participle (receives the action)?
q.ur: Kaunsa lafz ism-ul-mafool hai (jis par kaam ho)?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ اسْمُ مَفْعولٍ، أَيْ مَنْ وَقَعَ عَلَيْهِ الفِعْلُ؟

q.en: What does مَسْؤول mean?
q.ur: مَسْؤول ka kya matlab hai?

q.en: What does أَوْصَدَ mean?
q.ur: أَوْصَدَ ka kya matlab hai?
